next.reason: 1985 VII.4.2.3 SR1: 'The files referenced in the CLOSE statement need not all have the same organization or access.' 2023 has no sentence saying so, but nothing requires uniformity: §2023:14.9.6.2 repeats the file-name-1 group freely ('<u>CLOSE</u> ... file-name-1 ... …') and §2023:14.9.6.4 GR10 makes a multi-file CLOSE 'the same as if a separate CLOSE statement had been written for each file-name-1'. A CLOSE naming files of different organizations or access modes is accepted and means the same.
